newsitem.title: FRANCE: One dead, seven wounded in French hunting row.
newsitem.headline: One dead, seven wounded in French hunting row.

text.p: A man shot dead a police captain and wounded five other officers and a hunter after going beserk over a hunting dispute near the southern French town of Montelimar on Thursday, police said.
Police said they were called after the man, who lived in a shack in woods near the town, grabbed a shotgun from a hunter whom he accused of firing at game too close to his home.
The man, described by police as a social misfit and who has not been named, critically injured the hunter with a machete before firing a shotgun into his back, officers said.
When police arrived on the scene, he opened fire at them, killing the captain and wounding five officers, two seriously.
An exchange of fire followed during which the man was wounded and finally captured, police said.
